model.maintenance: non-negative affine map of execution-driven maintenance cycles
model.reader: round launches plus vertex-domain publication work plus completed reader AXI parent requests
model.compute_execution_span: round launches plus execution-driven compute cycles; AXI and bounded-pipeline stalls are already included
model.compute_fixed_plus_execution: one routed compute event launch/drain cost plus execution-driven compute cycles
model.compute_request_plus_execution: CC state-memory parent requests plus execution-driven compute cycles and round launches
model.iterative_span: max(reader, compute) plus a non-negative per-round routed overlap residual
model.total: maintenance plus iterative span; zero-round residual PageRank is maintenance-only

mechanism_mapping.reader_vertex_domain: full-domain active publication and downstream sweep visible in the routed reader event through AXIS backpressure
mechanism_mapping.reader_requests: issued equals completed reader AXI parent requests
mechanism_mapping.compute_cycles: evaluate-commit compute state, finite FIFOs, AXIS backpressure, HBM response timing, and on-chip pipeline stalls
mechanism_mapping.cc_compute_requests: algorithm-specific label-state traffic not represented by the SSSP execution-span mapping
mechanism_mapping.span: routed reader and compute event intervals overlap and are never summed

supersedes.reason: V14 double-counted memory service by adding parent-request cost to execution-driven component cycles. It failed frozen SO transfer for SSSP (48.96% total error) and CC (32.98%). V15 restores the previously validated HLS reader work terms and uses an algorithm-specific compute policy before freezing against LJ and LJ08 current-plugin runs.
